paragraph_checks.reviewed_text: US assets face a demanding labour-market test after equities have already rewarded softer activity. Bloomberg previews a substantial slowdown in June hiring; Reuters reports the dollar defensive after weak data. [[n2162]] [[n2159]] The hiring expectation remains a preview. A manageable cooling would support disinflation and eventual policy relief, while a more abrupt deterioration could reach earnings before financing becomes cheaper. Keep the portfolio concentrated in dependable cash generation and retain capacity to adjust after the actual release. The distinction is between relief that improves the operating environment and relief expected because the operating environment is deteriorating too quickly. The Bureau of Labor Statistics examines inflation across households grouped by income. [[n1256]] That encourages a customer-specific test: lower aggregate price pressure may help purchasing power unevenly because essential expenses and debt obligations differ. A company should demonstrate how its own buyers respond before investors assume the macro improvement becomes a volume recovery.
